title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing authorization checks to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The flaw arises because OAuthlib does not require the authenticated client's client_id to match the client_id parameter in the request body during grant and scope validation. This can lead to token authorization bypass where a low-privilege client obtains tokens with scopes or grant types assigned to a higher-privilege client.
